obligations.acceptance: Same physical resource across owner, Binding, Cell alias and proof refresh has one authority; actual version changes differ.
Release fully replaced BK and compaction input while logical messages remain; veto incomplete protocol, fallback, pin or member coverage.
Verify every floor/reference class by reason; no missing class or orphan adoption path can pass.
No Object configuration/service: both internal topics and user topic compact, publish, read, restart and reclaim old ledgers with complete indexes.
Unknown ledger creation, partial output, lost publication, empty output and unselected artifacts reconcile without Object.
More than 1024 completed batches in one Binding; bounded selector, active holes, replayed BatchId rejection and intact M4 projection.
Fold response loss, stale root, restart, missing/corrupt nodes and rollback attempt preserve terminal rejection.
Completed deletes exceed resident done cap; eviction/reload cannot recreate authority; durable quota and existing-intent progress observable.
Crash after CAS-1 before CAS-2; fence old owner, refresh capability/proof, reread full identity, reject late observation and complete same-resource deletion.
Every applicable real writer tests both ticket/fence orders, unknown external response, revocation, old-owner callback and sorted multi-target conflict.
Native completion/selection and exact M4 release compose with BK intent/done while subscriptions retain backlog; root-data-multipart order and lost response.
Per-Binding same-lane and other-Cell latency, queue bytes and convergence under slow/unknown PUT; shard-count assembly/recovery measurements.
Whole run leaves recovery set after all replay obligations transfer while selected long-lived Objects remain readable; blocked physical GC does not alone pin recovery budget.
Never callback, unconfirmed cancel, retained buffer, verified completion/drain and restart; retain absent qualified proof; healthy Binding retains capacity.
Descriptor/payload replay load, Applied lag and admitted journal faults; export exact native election interfaces without claiming M6 process activation.
All affected M2/M3 and shared M4 regressions on exact tested source with bounded Cell budgets and no skipped success.
All five exclusive children, matching source locks, raw artifacts, zero failures/errors/skips, independent source/attachment/archive validation and aggregate required.
